title: Uncertainty Evaluation to Support Safety of the Intended Functionality Analysis for Determining the Applicability of Performance Targets Across Triggering Conditions in ML-Based LiDAR Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.35092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) analysis according to ISO 21448, a machine learning object detector for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds can meet a performance target, a limit on the mean per-frame share of wrong detections among accepted detections, by rejecting detections above an uncertainty threshold. A threshold selected on data of one condition carries a statistical guarantee only for data distributed like its selection data, whereas SOTIF analysis covers every triggering condition. This paper presents an uncertainty evaluation in which the threshold is transferred into a triggering condition, a test decides at a stated error probability whether the target is applicable there, not applicable or not determined, and a lower bound counts the independent units an applicable outcome requires. translated_title: 支持预期功能安全（SOTIF）分析的不确定性评估：确定性能目标在基于机器学习的激光雷达目标检测各触发条件下的适用性
translated_abstract: 根据ISO 21448进行预期功能安全（SOTIF）分析时，针对激光雷达（LiDAR）点云的机器学习目标检测器可以通过拒绝超过不确定性阈值的检测，来满足一项性能目标，即限制每帧中被接受的检测里错误检测的平均占比。然而，在某一条件的数据上选定的阈值，仅对与该选择数据同分布的数据具有统计保证，而SOTIF分析需要覆盖每一个触发条件。本文提出了一种不确定性评估方法：将该阈值迁移到某一触发条件，通过统计检验以给定的错误概率判定性能目标在该条件下是“适用”、“不适用”还是“无法确定”，并以一个下界计算得出“适用”结论所需的独立样本单位数量。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上针对PointPillars集成模型、以记录序列为单位进行计数时，由于帧之间存在相关性……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性评估方法，通过统计检验判定机器学习LiDAR目标检测器的性能目标在某一触发条件下是否适用，从而支持符合ISO 21448的SOTIF分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty evaluation that uses statistical tests to determine whether a performance target for ML-based LiDAR object detection is applicable, not applicable, or undetermined under a given triggering condition, thereby supporting SOTIF analysis according to ISO 21448.
